basis.boundary: Inherited HTL fixed-background accounting: feed, heater/reactor electricity, fixed pump inventory, direct CO2/CH4 and wastewater; excludes separator heat duty and cooling-service burdens; not a full-plant utility inventory
basis.allocation_method: Single target; no co-product allocation; share 1
basis.enthalpy_basis: Complete material-stream enthalpy rates on one common reference; Q and W positive inward; no KE/PE or accumulation

training.selection: Fixed Matern 5/2 family; hyperparameters optimized using training-only marginal likelihood. No holdout-based model selection.

lineage_statement: Dataset digest checked. Native execution and lineage are declared by the producing runner/user; JSON alone does not prove Aspen execution.
scope: Mean-only interpolation inside declared bounds and actual training convex hull. No uncertainty bands, live Aspen execution or physical validation.

validation.scope: Error checks against supplied simulator outputs, not physical validation.
